notes.text: Current account may be blocked before timeline access by a human verification page at /accounts/suspended with the message 请验证你是真人来使用你的账户. Do not prepare or paste posting copy before clearing this gate.

workflows.name: Threads account gate check
workflows.description: Verify whether Threads is usable before drafting a post.
steps: If the site redirects to /accounts/suspended or shows a human verification message, stop immediately.
Ask the account owner to finish the manual verification first.
Only return to posting flow after timeline access is restored.
